name: Stepper
description: Multi-step wizard with a segmented, dot or bar progress indicator, animated step transitions, a height-animating content area and Back/Continue buttons. Supports dark and light themes.
contents: Progress indicator (numbered segments with a sliding glider, dots, or bars)
Animated content viewport showing the current Step child
Footer with Back and Continue/Complete buttons
Optional frosted glass frame around everything
Optional completed content shown after the last step
behavior: Works uncontrolled through initialStep or controlled through step
Content slides or fades between steps while the viewport height animates
Glider behind the active numbered segment moves with a spring easing
Completed steps show an animated checkmark
Vertical orientation shows a side rail with titles and descriptions, and folds to a row when the root is narrower than 520px
Labels collapse automatically when the row is too narrow for them
Reduced motion preference switches to fades and shorter durations
After the last step, the footer collapses and completedContent is shown
editableByProps: Step content, titles, descriptions and icons through Step children and their props
Button labels and button props, footer visibility
Initial or controlled step, linear mode, clickable indicators
Orientation, transition type, theme, accent color, frame, radius and width
Custom indicator rendering and completed content
Extra class names for the root, header, content and footer

needsCodeEdit.change: Change theme colors beyond the accent

needsCodeEdit.where: SPRING and SETTLE constants and the animate calls in the view.id layout effect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the vertical rail width or folding breakpoint
needsCodeEdit.where: measure function (520 check) and the w-[212px] class in the header container
shift constant in the view.id layout effect

fixed: Children must be Step elements (exported from the same file), each with optional title, description and icon props
Does not center itself or fill the viewport, it renders at min(100%, width) and the host positions it
Uses ResizeObserver and the Web Animations API, no global page or body changes
Vertical orientation always uses numbered indicators regardless of the indicator prop
Titles and descriptions are single-line and truncated with ellipsis
Works on small screens: width is capped to 100% and labels or the rail collapse when narrow

options.look: Segmented track with numbered badges, titles and a sliding glider behind the active step
options.useWhen: A signup or checkout wizard where users need labeled steps and can jump between them

options.look: Row of small centered dots with the active dot enlarged
options.useWhen: A short onboarding or intro flow in a compact card where step names are not needed

options.look: Row of thin progress bars that fill as steps are reached
options.useWhen: A quiz or survey form where overall progress matters more than step names
